plan: Create comprehensive article on underhook battle concept in BJJ. Cover: definition and importance, mechanical advantages, common positions (Dogfight, Butterfly Guard, Half Guard), grip fighting strategies, how to win underhook battles, defending against underhook pressure, drills and training methods. This fundamental concept is referenced extensively in Dogfight Position and other half guard positions but lacks standalone detailed coverage.

Create comparison guide for Lockdown vs Z-Lock vs Z-Guard positions. Include: side-by-side comparison table of leg configurations, when to use each variation, advantages/disadvantages, skill level requirements, success rates, transitions between variations, common confusion points. Address terminology clarity and help practitioners choose appropriate variation based on situation.

Create system overview article for 10th Planet Half Guard system. Cover: Eddie Bravo's philosophy and innovations, Lockdown fundamentals, Z-Lock advanced variation, Electric Chair submission, Old School sweep variations, Twister and truck positions, system hierarchy and progression, no-gi specific adaptations, recommended learning path for system mastery.

Create step-by-step tutorial for entering Dogfight Position from flat half guard. Include: prerequisites and positioning, establishing the underhook, hip elevation sequence, coming to knees safely, maintaining frames during elevation, common mistakes during entry, drills for entry practice, troubleshooting failed entries, video resource recommendations.

Create detailed submission article for Electric Chair. Cover: position definition and mechanics, relationship to Z-Lock and Lockdown, setup from various positions, breaking mechanics and pressure points, safety considerations and tap signals, common defenses and counters, success rates by skill level, training progressions, expert insights from 10th Planet practitioners.

Create tactical decision guide for half guard variations. Answer: Which half guard variation to use when? Include decision tree based on: opponent's passing style, gi vs no-gi context, your skill level and physical attributes, position of opponent's weight, space available, energy level considerations. Help practitioners make strategic choices between Dogfight, Deep Half, Z-Lock, Lockdown, Knee Shield variations.
